title: Share of oceanic shark & ray species threatened with extinction

source.name: Half a century of global decline in oceanic sharks and rays
source.publisher: Pacoureau et al., Nature (2021); IUCN Red List

notes: The study found three-quarters of the oceanic shark and ray species it assessed are now threatened with extinction under IUCN Red List criteria. This is specific to the 31 open-ocean (pelagic) species studied, not all sharks and rays worldwide.
